node.title: Re: Error in excel reader
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$Excel->WorksheetFunction->Find("IB_MsgSig","E","Go Notifier Customization Availability Flag 2");

You are accessing [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.worksheetfunction.find|WorksheetFunction.Find], which does the same as the Excel function [https://support.office.com/en-us/article/find-findb-functions-c7912941-af2a-4bdf-a553-d0d89b0a0628|FIND]. I suspect you might want [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.range.find|Range.Find] instead.
